project_info.theme: Minimal cinematic brand statement disrupted by glass
project_info.color_palette: Clean white or pale gray, black typography, transparent glass highlights, controlled brand accent

main_subject.detail: A [BRAND NAME] poster with a black extra-bold slogan and a three-dimensional translucent glass strip that refracts and distorts part of the words and layout.
main_subject.style: Clean modern graphic design, precise 3D glass optics, polished product-render realism

composition_elements.type: Typography, logo, glass layer, and product object
items: Top corner: small approved [BRAND NAME] logo.
Center: bold black brand message and exactly six-word slogan.
Across the composition: diagonal or curved 3D clear glass plane causing visible optical distortion.
Upper or side: one brand-relevant product or sculptural object on the uncluttered background.
Background: clean pale neutral field with smooth shadows and glossy highlights.

lighting_and_atmosphere.effect: Smooth soft shadows, crisp glass refraction, subtle chromatic edge shift, controlled reflective highlights

technical_specs.render_style: Premium 3D product poster and minimalist graphic design

assets.name: Approved [BRAND NAME] logo
assets.usage: Place at the top corner at restrained scale.

assets.name: Approved product reference
assets.source: official product imagery or licensed reference
assets.usage: Match the included object if exact product identity matters.

assets.name: Glass-distortion typography layout
assets.usage: Match oversized black type, clean spacing, and refraction path.

prompt_instructions: Use approved brand assets when exact logos or products are required.
Keep the slogan exactly six words and retain readable undistorted letterforms outside the glass.

prompt.generated_prompt_string: Design a cinematic brand poster featuring '[BRAND NAME]' - include a bold six-word slogan beneath - apply a 3D glass refraction effect that distorts part of the text or layout - incorporate the brand logo in the top corner - smooth shadows, glossy lighting, black extra-bold typography - clean modern background - high-resolution, 1:1 aspect ratio.
prompt.negative_prompt: dark clutter, opaque glass, unreadable slogan, weak refraction, thin typography, warped logo, noisy background, low resolution, watermark, signature
